interface.signature: routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int -> int

preconditions.expression: isinstance(routes, list) and all(isinstance(route, list) and all(isinstance(stop, int) for stop in route) for route in routes)
preconditions.description: routes is a list of lists, where each inner list contains integers representing bus stops.
S is an integer representing the starting bus stop.
T is an integer representing the destination bus stop.
The number of bus routes is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(route) <= 10**5 for route in routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route contains between 1 and 100,000 bus stops.

postconditions.description: The return value is either -1 (if it is not possible to reach the destination) or a positive integer representing the minimum number of buses needed.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(any(stop == S for stop in routes[bus]) for bus in range(return_value))
postconditions.description: If a valid number of buses is returned, it is possible to reach the destination using that many buses starting from stop S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or any(any(stop == T for stop in routes[bus]) for bus in range(return_value))
postconditions.description: If a valid number of buses is returned, it is possible to reach the destination stop T using that many buses.
